lines.zh: 我扇几下翅膀，就飘出去一段。
lines.en: A few wingbeats carry me along.
Flying at night, the wind is cool.
I fly along the forest edge, hunting flowers.

lines.zh: 我的尾突很长，飞起来拖着。
lines.en: My long tails trail behind in flight.

lines.zh: 我飞得不高，就在树下来回。
lines.en: I keep low, back and forth under the trees.
Moonlight on my wings. Pale green.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树飞了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a tree twice.

lines.zh: 翅膀一停，我就往下沉一点。
lines.en: When I stop flapping, I sink a little.
I slip between two leaves.

lines.zh: 这点距离，我一会儿就到。
lines.en: That far? I'll be there shortly.

lines.zh: 月形翅上的尾突，指着我回家的路。
lines.en: The tails on my moon wings point home.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，留下一股粉味。
lines.en: A dust of pollen trails where I fly.

lines.zh: 夜里的林子，比白天安静。
lines.en: The forest at night is quieter than by day.

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖飞，怕撞到枝。
lines.en: I skim the grass tips, avoiding branches.
Where there's light, I go around.
I head straight for that white flower.

lines.zh: 我停在叶子上，翅膀合起来。
lines.en: I settle on a leaf and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 夜里我不太动，只是听着。
lines.en: At night I stay still and listen.
My wings are pale green. Very thin.
One antenna sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 月牙形的尾突贴着叶背，凉。
lines.en: My crescent tails rest cold against the leaf.

lines.zh: 花开着，我就记住了位置。
lines.en: The flower's open. I've marked the spot.
I open my wings slowly. Then close them.
Dew on the ground. I won't go down.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，晚上很好看。
lines.en: This forest is lovely at night.
I make no noise. Not even my wings.

lines.zh: 我的寿命不长，得省着用。
lines.en: My life isn't long. I must spend it carefully.
A light in the distance. I won't go.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我往后仰了一点。
lines.en: The wind comes and I lean back a little.

lines.zh: 一朵雏菊在下面，我没急着下。
lines.en: A daisy below. I don't hurry down.

lines.zh: 你站在花旁边，我绕了一圈。
lines.en: You stand by the flowers. I circle once.
I don't know the things of the night well.

lines.zh: 我停在你手边，扇了两下翅。
lines.en: I settle by your hand and beat my wings twice.

lines.zh: 你身上的光是暖的，我不敢碰。
lines.en: Your light is warm. I don't dare touch it.
You're big, but you're quiet.
I land on a petal and look at you.

lines.zh: 我往上飘了一点，你够不到。
lines.en: I drift up a little, out of reach.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹得我翅边的粉动。
lines.en: Your breath stirs the dust along my wing edge.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞了半圈，又回去。
lines.en: I circle you half way and return.
You don't smell of flowers.

lines.zh: 我的翅被碰了一下，飞不稳。
lines.en: A wing took a knock. I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 我掉下去一点，又飞回来。
lines.en: I drop a bit, then recover.
Some pollen fell off my wings.

lines.zh: 我落到叶子上，先歇一歇。
lines.en: I land on a leaf to rest.
Don't squeeze. I can't take it.

lines.zh: 这一下让我飞得低了很多。
lines.en: That put me much lower.
I don't cry out. I don't struggle.
A wing edge is torn. I can still fly.
I circle half a turn to level out.
Don't touch my antennae.
Is this flower for me?

lines.zh: 我慢慢落下去，落在边上。
lines.en: I drift down and land on the rim.
The daisy's smell — I know it.
I unroll my tube and drink.
Not enough here. I'll find more.
You lift it high; I circle.
I must feed while the night lasts.
Pollen on my legs. Good.
That smell pulled me around three times.
Don't pick it. Let it stay open.

lines.zh: 我撞到叶子上，落了一点。
lines.en: I hit a leaf and drop a little.
A wing was knocked; I fly crooked.
That shook the pollen off me.
I go around you and land back on the flower.
I'm fragile. One touch knocks me off course.
You moved too fast. I didn't dodge.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，稳了一会儿。
lines.en: I hover and steady myself.
A wing edge is curled. I smooth it.
That dropped me a block.

lines.zh: 别在花旁边伸手，会撞到。
lines.en: Don't reach in by the flowers. You'll hit me.
At night I release a little scent.

lines.zh: 远处也有一样的光在动。
lines.en: The same pale glimmer moves far off.

lines.zh: 她翅上的尾突，和我的对得上。
lines.en: Her hindwing tails match mine.

lines.zh: 翅膀对着翅膀，扇得一样快。
lines.en: Wing to wing, beating at the same rate.
This is brief. Only a few nights.
I set the eggs on the underside of a leaf.
Afterward I fly off.
The leaf will keep them for me.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我得找地方停。
lines.en: Near dawn. I must find somewhere to rest.
This season is only long enough for this.
I land on a flower and sip a little.
Not edible. I fly off.
I pick up a little pollen on my legs.
I can't hold on to this petal.
I cling to the stamen and drink slowly.

lines.zh: 我用腿夹起一片湿花瓣。
lines.en: I clamp a wet petal between my legs.

lines.zh: 我把它抖到另一朵花上。
lines.en: I shake it onto another flower.
Wrong smell. I leave.
I pause, then lift off.
The flower stays. I'll come back.
That flower's open. I see it.
I raise my wings and hover first.
At this distance, one flight.

lines.zh: 有人在花旁边，我得小心。
lines.en: Someone's by the flowers. Careful.
I fly toward that white bloom.
My antennae reach out to smell first.
Tonight's wind favors me.
Don't touch that flower. I need it.
I circle once to pick a landing spot.
That one. No other.
I keep flying at that flower.
If you won't move, I'll go around.
I hover above the flower and wait.
A little wind. No trouble.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降低，怕碰坏花瓣。
lines.en: I descend slowly so I don't bruise the petals.
You step back, and I land.

lines.zh: 这朵花，我盯了一会儿了。
lines.en: I've had my eye on this flower a while.
Soft petals. I must be gentle.
One block closer and I'm there.

lines.zh: 夜里时间不多，我不等了。
lines.en: The night is short. I won't wait.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下，没什么力气。
lines.en: I bump into it. Not much force.
My wing sweeps past. Only wind.

lines.zh: 这一下，把花粉撒出去了。
lines.en: That scattered the pollen.
I don't bite. I can't.

lines.zh: 我没力气，只把鳞粉抖在你脸上。
lines.en: I have no strength; I only shake scales into your face.
I hit and fly off without looking back.

lines.zh: 我翅上的月牙，夜里才亮。
lines.en: The crescents on my wings shine only at night.
I land on your hand. Very light.
That rocked me too.
I go around you and back to the flower.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里出来，翅还是湿的。
lines.en: I come out of the chrysalis, wings still damp.

lines.zh: 夜里刚起，我先扇了几下。
lines.en: Night just fell. I beat my wings a few times.
Pale green wings slowly unfold.
I settle on the nearest leaf.
So many flowers. A whole night's work.

lines.zh: 蛹壳裂开，我把湿翅摊在夜里。
lines.en: The cocoon splits; I spread wet wings into the night.

lines.zh: 翅一扇，整片林子都动了。
lines.en: One wingbeat and the whole forest stirs.

lines.zh: 我第一次飞，比我猜的稳。
lines.en: My first flight. Steadier than I guessed.

lines.zh: 这里的花，和我记忆里一样。
lines.en: The flowers here match my memory.
I dry my wings before flying far.
Fire comes near and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 翅被草茎挂住，我坠下去。
lines.en: A grass stem snags my wing, and I drop.

lines.zh: 水粘住我的翅，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Water sticks my wings. I can't fly.
The blast blows me far away.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我的翅，破了个洞。
lines.en: Something passed through my wing. There's a hole.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光罩着我，翅都发烫。
lines.en: Strange light covers me and my wings burn.

lines.zh: 好几天没花蜜，我没力气了。
lines.en: Days without nectar. I'm spent.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片林子，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole forest and I can't see.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我控制不住。
lines.en: Emptiness below. I can't control it.
